migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Clarified the public rubric wording and evidence descriptions. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. Measured release blockers override the numerical grade. Check every required device/task pair and the string inventory guard. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds event-level caption timing, paired device motion, build guard output and locale-specific glyph and truncation evidence. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles single-input.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

single-language.reason: For a single-language release, score the string inventory. Use the default profile when additional locales enter scope.

single-input.reason: The game supports one input method, so there is nothing to remap or switch. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks. Each confirmed release blocker sets verdict BLOCKED and grade 0. Supported points, coverage and the evidence interval retain their uncapped values. Unmeasured safety evidence prevents PASS.
source: Input traces, accessibility settings, string inventories and captures from the supported locales.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

releaseBlockers.reason: Flashing above the approved safety limit blocks release.
